an7.44:1.3: Santi bhikkhave sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathā pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
an7.44:2.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā Brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā.
an7.44:3.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā Ābhassarā .
an7.44:4.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā pi devā Subhakiṇhā .
an7.44:5.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamma paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso' ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā.
an7.44:6.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan' ti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā.
an7.44:7.1: Santi bhikkhave sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī' ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā.
an7.44:8.1: Imā kho bhikkhave satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo ti. 1.
